content.page_summary: Reference list focused on use of natriuretic peptides (BNP, NT-proBNP, N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide, B-type natriuretic peptide) in diagnosis, prognosis, assay performance, clinical guidance, and factors affecting concentrations (eg, obesity) primarily in heart failure and primary care settings. Also includes studies comparing peptide assays and echo-Doppler correlation with filling pressures.
topics_covered: Clinical utility of natriuretic peptides (BNP, NT-proBNP) for diagnosis and prognosis of heart failure
Guidance on use of natriuretic peptide concentrations in practice
Diagnostic accuracy and meta-analysis of natriuretic peptides in acute care
Correlation of NT-proBNP with left ventricular filling pressures and echocardiography
Effect of obesity on natriuretic peptide concentrations
Comparison and utility of different BNP/NT-proBNP assay methods
Point-of-care NT-proBNP cut-off optimization for primary care
